method: Al-Mohy & Higham expmv (truncated Taylor with scaling, Algorithm 3.2), author MATLAB code run in Octave with a thin FAMEXP2 adapter
citation: A. H. Al-Mohy and N. J. Higham, Computing the action of the matrix exponential, with an application to exponential integrators, SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 33(2):488-511, 2011

policy.phi1: first n entries of expm(t*[[-L, b1]; [0, 0]]) * [b0; 1]
policy.precision: per tolerance level from calibration.json: p4 single, p7 double, p10 double
policy.degenerate: t=0, zero operator or both rhs zero: y = b0 + t*b1
policy.shift_and_balance: author defaults (trace shift on, balancing off)

calibration.rule: cheapest of half < single < double per level with every public request within 0.1 of the allowed error
